modifications.patch:
--- rtl/ai7030_edif_top.v
+++ rtl/ai7030_edif_top.v
@@ -254,7 +254,7 @@
 // Native byte strobes are supplied by the CustomOp wrapper.
 
 
-wcis_face_customop U_adder_top(
+wcis_recording_customop U_adder_top(
   .itf_ra_awaddr    (User_Reg_awwaddr      ),
   .itf_ra_awdata    (User_Reg_awwdata      ),
   .itf_ra_awvalid   (User_Reg_awwvalid     ),

--- constrs_1/ai7030.xdc
+++ constrs_1/ai7030.xdc
@@ -10,9 +10,9 @@
 set_false_path -to [get_ports {led[1]}]
 set_false_path -from [get_clocks clk_out1_clk_wiz_0] -to [get_clocks clk_out2_clk_wiz_0]
 set_false_path -from [get_clocks clk_out2_clk_wiz_0] -to [get_clocks clk_out1_clk_wiz_0]
-set task_legacy_regs [filter [all_registers -clock [get_clocks clk_pll_i]] {NAME !~ "U_adder_top/read_request/m_data_reg*" && NAME !~ "U_adder_top/write_request/m_data_reg*"}]
+set task_legacy_regs [filter [all_registers -clock [get_clocks clk_pll_i]] {NAME !~ "U_adder_top/face/read_request/m_data_reg*" && NAME !~ "U_adder_top/face/write_request/m_data_reg*" && NAME !~ "U_adder_top/jpeg/read_request/m_data_reg*" && NAME !~ "U_adder_top/jpeg/write_request/m_data_reg*"}]
 set_false_path -from [get_clocks clk_out1_clk_wiz_0] -to $task_legacy_regs
-set task_legacy_regs [filter [all_registers -clock [get_clocks clk_out1_clk_wiz_0]] {NAME !~ "U_adder_top/read_response/m_data_reg*"}]
+set task_legacy_regs [filter [all_registers -clock [get_clocks clk_out1_clk_wiz_0]] {NAME !~ "U_adder_top/face/read_response/m_data_reg*" && NAME !~ "U_adder_top/jpeg/read_response/m_data_reg*"}]
 set_false_path -from [get_clocks clk_pll_i] -to $task_legacy_regs
 set_false_path -from [get_clocks clk_out1_sys_clk] -to [get_clocks clk_out1_mgtclk]

--- constrs_1/impl_constraints.xdc
+++ constrs_1/impl_constraints.xdc
@@ -67,25 +67,49 @@
 # response has >=2 GP cycles. Never blanket-cut their bundled data paths.
 
 # FACE read_request
-set task_sync [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/read_request/(request_sync|ack_sync)_reg\[0\]}]
+set task_sync [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/face/read_request/(request_sync|ack_sync)_reg\[0\]}]
 set_false_path -to [get_pins -of_objects $task_sync -filter {REF_PIN_NAME == D}]
-set task_hold [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/read_request/payload_hold_reg\[[0-9]+\]}]
-set task_capture [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/read_request/m_data_reg\[[0-9]+\]}]
+set task_hold [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/face/read_request/payload_hold_reg\[[0-9]+\]}]
+set task_capture [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/face/read_request/m_data_reg\[[0-9]+\]}]
 set_max_delay -datapath_only 8.0 -from $task_hold -to $task_capture
 set_bus_skew 8.0 -from $task_hold -to $task_capture
 
 # FACE write_request
-set task_sync [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/write_request/(request_sync|ack_sync)_reg\[0\]}]
+set task_sync [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/face/write_request/(request_sync|ack_sync)_reg\[0\]}]
 set_false_path -to [get_pins -of_objects $task_sync -filter {REF_PIN_NAME == D}]
-set task_hold [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/write_request/payload_hold_reg\[[0-9]+\]}]
-set task_capture [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/write_request/m_data_reg\[[0-9]+\]}]
+set task_hold [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/face/write_request/payload_hold_reg\[[0-9]+\]}]
+set task_capture [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/face/write_request/m_data_reg\[[0-9]+\]}]
 set_max_delay -datapath_only 8.0 -from $task_hold -to $task_capture
 set_bus_skew 8.0 -from $task_hold -to $task_capture
 
 # FACE read_response
-set task_sync [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/read_response/(request_sync|ack_sync)_reg\[0\]}]
+set task_sync [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/face/read_response/(request_sync|ack_sync)_reg\[0\]}]
 set_false_path -to [get_pins -of_objects $task_sync -filter {REF_PIN_NAME == D}]
-set task_hold [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/read_response/payload_hold_reg\[[0-9]+\]}]
-set task_capture [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/read_response/m_data_reg\[[0-9]+\]}]
+set task_hold [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/face/read_response/payload_hold_reg\[[0-9]+\]}]
+set task_capture [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/face/read_response/m_data_reg\[[0-9]+\]}]
 set_max_delay -datapath_only 20.0 -from $task_hold -to $task_capture
 set_bus_skew 20.0 -from $task_hold -to $task_capture
+
+# JPEG read_request bundled-data mailbox
+set task_sync [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/jpeg/read_request/(request_sync|ack_sync)_reg\[0\]}]
+set_false_path -to [get_pins -of_objects $task_sync -filter {REF_PIN_NAME == D}]
+set task_hold [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/jpeg/read_request/payload_hold_reg\[[0-9]+\]}]
+set task_capture [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/jpeg/read_request/m_data_reg\[[0-9]+\]}]
+set_max_delay -datapath_only 8.0 -from $task_hold -to $task_capture
+set_bus_skew 8.0 -from $task_hold -to $task_capture
+
+# JPEG write_request bundled-data mailbox
+set task_sync [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/jpeg/write_request/(request_sync|ack_sync)_reg\[0\]}]
+set_false_path -to [get_pins -of_objects $task_sync -filter {REF_PIN_NAME == D}]
+set task_hold [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/jpeg/write_request/payload_hold_reg\[[0-9]+\]}]
+set task_capture [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/jpeg/write_request/m_data_reg\[[0-9]+\]}]
+set_max_delay -datapath_only 8.0 -from $task_hold -to $task_capture
+set_bus_skew 8.0 -from $task_hold -to $task_capture
+
+# JPEG read_response bundled-data mailbox
+set task_sync [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/jpeg/read_response/(request_sync|ack_sync)_reg\[0\]}]
+set_false_path -to [get_pins -of_objects $task_sync -filter {REF_PIN_NAME == D}]
+set task_hold [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/jpeg/read_response/payload_hold_reg\[[0-9]+\]}]
+set task_capture [get_cells -hier -regexp {.*U_adder_top/jpeg/read_response/m_data_reg\[[0-9]+\]}]
+set_max_delay -datapath_only 20.0 -from $task_hold -to $task_capture
+set_bus_skew 20.0 -from $task_hold -to $task_capture
